description: This file contains functions and interfaces for extracting images from message content, downloading media files, and handling media attachments in a Tlon/Urbit environment.

methods.name: extractImageBlocks
methods.description: Extracts image URLs and alt text from message content, limited to a maximum number of images.

methods.name: downloadMedia
methods.description: Downloads a media file from a URL to local storage, validating URL protocol and determining file extension.

methods.name: downloadMessageImages
methods.description: Downloads all images from message content and returns attachment metadata.
